x-digest-projection.encoding: 每token=无前导零的UTF-8字节数十进制+冒号+原UTF-8字节；null为空token、整数十进制、时间固定UTC RFC3339秒；不规范化文本或路径。

registration.repeated_field: include_paths[] expands to one token per sorted exact path after the count token; never join with commas

source_input.purpose: Private canonical source input hash within domain+Document uniqueness; excludes timestamps/progress/upload keys and does not replace source/revision identity.

x-state-machine.retry: 整件从0显式重传；不支持分片。GET不自动上传或确认。

x-error-rules.if_range_mismatch: 忽略Range返回完整200；HEAD无条件忽略Range/If-Range
x-error-rules.c1_text_and_0_4_manifest: 拒绝original_only，不自动降级或创建文本根

x-media-rules.extension_case: ASCII lower only for recognition; original filename/path bytes remain unchanged

x-upload-outcomes.slot_release: terminal rejected/cancelled/expired/committed releases logical open/reserved bytes; interrupted/ready retain until terminal; active epoch receiving slot remains reserved until stopped/lease expiry
